stem.text: An archer shoots an arrow at a target. The diagram shows the path of the arrow.

stem.alt: Diagram of an archer holding a bow, with a curved path of an arrow from the archer to a target. Labels: archer, path of arrow, target.

stem.text: Air resistance is assumed to be negligible.
The graphs show how three different quantities $p$, $q$ and $r$, relating to the motion of the arrow, vary with time.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled p and horizontal axis labelled time, showing a horizontal straight line.
Graph with vertical axis labelled q and horizontal axis labelled time, showing a straight line from the origin rising to the right.
Graph with vertical axis labelled r and horizontal axis labelled time, showing a curve that rises to a peak and falls back to the time axis.

stem.text: Which quantity is the horizontal component of displacement and which quantity is the vertical component of displacement of the arrow?
